settings.label: Why Join
settings.heading_html: The Sabdia agent program gives you a genuine edge.

settings.title: Pre-Release Access
settings.desc: Be first to know about upcoming developments before they reach the public market. Give your clients a genuine first-mover advantage.

settings.title: Floor Plans & Pricing
settings.desc: Access pre-launch floor plans and indicative pricing information exclusively — everything you need to prepare your clients before public release.

settings.title: Priority Communication
settings.desc: A dedicated Sabdia liaison to keep you informed, respond to questions, and support you throughout the sales process.

settings.title: Exclusive Commissions
settings.desc: Competitive and exclusive commission structures for agent network members — recognising the value of your relationships and referrals.

settings.title: Private Previews
settings.desc: Invitations to exclusive agent-only preview events — an opportunity to walk through completed or near-complete residences before public launch.

settings.title: Award-Winning Product
settings.desc: Represent Brisbane's most acclaimed boutique luxury developer — a brand that your clients will immediately recognise as a hallmark of quality.

settings.label: Apply for Access
settings.text: Complete the form and a member of the Sabdia team will be in touch within one business day to discuss your application and confirm your access to our exclusive agent program.
settings.note_text: The Sabdia agent program is available to licensed real estate professionals only. We may request verification of your licence at the time of application approval.
